description: This file contains utility functions for managing challenge files, metadata, and curriculum structure in a FreeCodeCamp project, including creating, updating, deleting challenge and step files, and handling challenge metadata.

methods.name: getAllBlocks
methods.description: Retrieves a list of unique block dashed names from the curriculum structure.

methods.name: createStepFile
methods.description: Creates a new step markdown file with a generated ObjectId and template content.

methods.name: createChallengeFile
methods.description: Creates a challenge markdown file with specified filename and template content.

methods.name: createQuizFile
methods.description: Creates a quiz challenge markdown file with specified parameters and template content.

methods.name: createDialogueFile
methods.description: Creates a dialogue challenge markdown file with specified parameters and template content.

methods.name: insertChallengeIntoMeta
methods.description: Inserts a challenge entry into the challenge order metadata at a specified index.

methods.name: insertStepIntoMeta
methods.description: Inserts a step entry into the challenge order metadata at a specified position.

methods.name: deleteStepFromMeta
methods.description: Removes a step from the challenge order metadata based on step number.

methods.name: deleteChallengeFromMeta
methods.description: Removes a challenge from the challenge order metadata based on index.

methods.name: updateTaskMeta
methods.description: Updates challenge titles to reflect task numbering based on challenge type.

methods.name: updateStepTitles
methods.description: Updates the titles and dashed names of step markdown files based on current challenge order.

methods.name: updateTaskMarkdownFiles
methods.description: Updates markdown files for task challenges to reflect correct task numbering.

methods.name: getChallenge
methods.description: Reads and parses a challenge markdown file into a Challenge object.

methods.name: validateBlockName
methods.description: Validates a block name against existing blocks and naming rules.
